name: binhex-crafty-4
description: Crafty Controller is a free and open-source Minecraft launcher and manager that allows users to start and administer Minecraft servers from a user-friendly interface. The interface is run as a self-hosted web server that is accessible to devices on the local network by default and can be port forwarded to provide external access outside of your local network. Crafty is designed to be easy to install and use, requiring only a bit of technical knowledge and a desire to learn to get started. Crafty Controller is still actively being developed by Arcadia Technology and we are continually making major improvements to the software.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

ports.name: Port: Web Interface (HTTPS)
ports.description: This is the HTTPS Web UI port for for the application.

ports.name: Port: Minecraft Bedrock servers (TCP)
ports.description: This is the TCP port range for Minecrasft Bedrock servers.

ports.name: Port: Minecraft Bedrock servers (UDP)
ports.description: This is the UDP port range for Minecrasft Bedrock servers.

ports.name: Port: Minecraft Java servers (TCP)
ports.description: This is the TCP port range for Minecraft Java servers.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container
